Convergence: The architectural pattern where independent threads collapse to one place/moment
Warren: A magical path; each is a metaphysical realm with its own logic
Ascendant: Mortal who has risen to god-adjacent power; often through suffering
Bridgeburners: The elite Malazan military unit, ground-bass of the series
Bonehunters: The post-Bridgeburners military unit; carries the later series
Imass: First human civilization, ritually undying to wage war on the Jaghut
T'lan Imass: The undying form of the Imass; bound by the Ritual of Tellann
Tiste Andii: The Children of Mother Dark; exiled elder-kind of unimaginable age
Jaghut: Ancient solitary elder-kind; half of Imass/Jaghut war
Deck of Dragons: Divinatory deck representing the pantheon and its Houses
High House Death: Hood's House; the aspect governing ending
Soletaken / D'ivers: Shapeshifter taxonomies — single form vs. swarm
Kurald Galain: Warren of darkness; Tiste Andii origin
Crippled God: Broken god chained to the world; central figure of the final convergence
Malazan Empire: The human political entity; Kellanved and Dancer its founders
Ritual of Tellann: The Imass binding ritual that traded mortality for endless war
